selection_policy.window_policy: The coordinator selects a fixed window. Roots are never selected or pruned by the reader.
selection_policy.focus_root_policy: All roots occurring in the focus ayah are included in first-seen focus order with full non-contaminated branch inventories.
selection_policy.context_root_policy: All roots occurring in non-focus context ayat are included in packet order and root order. Each occurrence includes source_phrase_ar. Rootless context ayat are retained as text-only context and have no branch-citable roots.
selection_policy.non_focus_branch_policy: Every context root with a non-contaminated inventory includes all branch IDs in 'images' mode; this always includes branch_image_ar.
selection_policy.root_mapping_policy: QAC roots are resolved through qac-furuq-v4-root-map.sqlite.gz. If a QAC root maps to multiple Furuq root_ids, every mapped root and its non-contaminated branches are included in target_rank order. Branch IDs are root-local, so reader citations must pair branch_id with mapped_root_id.
selection_policy.source_phrase_policy: source_phrase_ar is deterministically derived from QAC surfaces_ar for the root occurrence in that source ayah.

context_ayat.text_ar: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ
context_ayat.text_norm_ar: وهم علي ما يفعلون بالمؤمنين شهود

context_ayat.text_ar: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
context_ayat.text_norm_ar: وما نقموا منهم الا ان يؤمنوا بالله العزيز الحميد

context_ayat.text_ar: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
context_ayat.text_norm_ar: الذي له ملك السموت والارض والله علي كل شيء شهيد

context_ayat.text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
context_ayat.text_norm_ar: ان الذين فتنوا المؤمنين والمؤمنت ثم لم يتوبوا فلهم عذاب جهنم ولهم عذاب الحريق

context_ayat.text_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
context_ayat.text_norm_ar: ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر ذلك الفوز الكبير
